title: LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice has inverted TWAP/spot ternary, defeating oracle manipulation resistance
description: getTokenPrice returns `lookback > 0 ? getPrice(...) : getTwap(..., lookback)`. The branches are reversed: when a TWAP is requested (lookback>0) it returns the instantaneous spot price, and when a spot price is requested (lookback==0) it calls getTwap with lookback=0, whose final return divides by lookback (zero).
impact: Any consumer requesting a manipulation-resistant TWAP silently receives a manipulable spot price; spot requests divide by zero. If a reachable mint/convert/peg path requests lookback>0 through this function, flash-loan price manipulation of Bean issuance or conversions becomes possible. High (pending confirmation of a reachable financial consumer).

ite.intent: Return TWAP when lookback>0, spot when lookback==0
ite.technique: Ternary condition inverted between the two helper calls
ite.evasion: Attacker requests/relies on a path expecting TWAP but gets manipulable spot

ice_chain.corrupted_state: oracle return value: spot instead of TWAP for lookback>0
ice_chain.impact: Manipulable price feeds into Bean minting/conversion economics
ice_chain.exploit_path: consumer calls getTokenPrice(addr,timeout,lookback>0) -> receives spot -> flash-loan skews spot -> mint/convert mispriced
